## Changes

- Fix an immediate crash when starting on-device podcast subtitle recognition on newer ARMv9 devices (such as Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phones).

Pre-release build for verifying the on-device recognition crash fix on affected devices. Requires Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device.

## 更新内容

- 修复在新款 ARMv9 设备（如骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5 机型）上点击播客端侧字幕“开始识别”时立即闪退的问题。

本版本为预发布构建，用于验证受影响机型的播客端侧字幕识别闪退修复。需要 Android 8.0 或更新系统，以及 ARM64 设备。
